verdict.rationale: Clara is an API-first SaaS, so headless automation runs through its REST API rather than a runnable tool. The API covers cards, transactions, users and invoices, with self-serve API credentials (mTLS), an OpenAPI 3.1 schema for typed clients, runnable code examples, and an isolated sandbox for end-to-end testing without real money movement. This supports unattended scripted automation, but nothing documents a CLI, a CI-specific integration or guide, or a pattern for non-interactive pipeline runs. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs or examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.
